description:
The smallest, fastest and most feature-rich free PDF viewer/editor on the market.

PDF-XChange Editor is a fast, lightweight, and feature-rich PDF viewer, editor, and annotation tool for Windows. It is known for its high performance and extensive functionality, positioning itself as a powerful alternative to Adobe Acrobat.

Key Features:
- Editing Tools: Directly edit text and images in PDF documents.
- Annotation & Markup: A vast array of tools for highlighting, adding comments, stamps, shapes, and handwritten notes.
- OCR (Optical Character Recognition): Convert scanned documents into searchable and editable text.
- Form Creation & Filling: Create, edit, and fill interactive PDF forms.
- Security Features: Add passwords, redact sensitive information, and manage digital signatures.
- Customization: Highly customizable interface and toolbar layouts.
- Low System Impact: Noted for its small footprint and fast operation, even with large files.
Bug fixes and other updates/enhancements:
1. Fixed a very infrequent crash on application close.
2. Fixed some security and stability issues. Click here for further information.
3. Fixed a possible crash in the 'Recolor Pages' operation when used in 'Remap Colors' mode.
4. Applied fixes to the Save Document procedure to avoid adding the 'temporary' attribute to the destination file. This attribute can affect cloud synchronization software, which often skips files with it during synchronization. (49875)
5. Fixed display artifacts apparent during page scrolling when the bottom of the page viewport was positioned far beyond the monitor boundaries. (T# 7933).
6. A number of fixes have been implemented to resolve complex conflicts between the new file Open/Save dialog box component and cloud file systems (specifically SharePoint). When users attempted to "Check Out" documents opened from SharePoint, a "No permissions" error could sometimes occur.
7. Fixed an issue with the 'Copy Selected Text Style' and 'Make Selected Text Style Default' functions, related to copying the color of selected text into the text style settings.
8. Fixed a rare issue where the 'Select Folder' dialog box would fail to appear when using the 'Search pane > Where to search > Browse for Folder' feature during remote desktop sessions, or on certain systems.
9. Fixed an issue that occurred when there were several editable combo boxes in the Properties pane. When users entered custom values the autocomplete feature could select a similar item from the list—sometimes completely replacing the user input and disrupting the cursor position.
10. The application startup time has been reduced in cases where users have many stamp collections and/or those collections are large.
11. Improved the rendering of U3D models.
